question: What ritual recitation accomplishes the purification of the five fundamental elements?
premises: Prior internal purification has already been performed.
Purification of the five elements is the intended aim.
The five Brahman mantras are designated for recitation.
inference: Chanting the five Brahman mantras accomplishes the purification of the five elements.
uncertainties: manūn is taken as mantras or sacred formulas associated with the five Brahmans.
plain_english: For the purification of the five elements, one should chant the five Brahman mantras.
